factual_claims.claim: The report is based on two surveys: a nationally representative survey of 5,410 U.S. adults (American Trends Panel, Aug. 12-18, 2024, margin of error +/- 1.6 percentage points) and a survey of 1,013 U.S.-based AI experts (Aug. 14-Oct. 31, 2024, margin of error +/- 3.1 percentage points).

AI experts are defined as U.S.-based individuals whose work or research relates to artificial intelligence and who presented at or published in any of 21 different AI-focused conferences in 2023 and 2024.
Responses from the AI expert survey are unweighted and are only representative of the views of those who responded, due to the lack of a definitive source of population benchmarks for this group.
The survey includes a total sample size of 551 Asian adults, primarily English-speaking, and therefore may not be representative of the overall Asian adult population.
